Class PhoneticEngine

java.lang.Object
org.apache.commons.codec.language.bm.PhoneticEngine
public class PhoneticEngine extends Object
Converts words into potential phonetic representations.

This is a two-stage process. Firstly, the word is converted into a phonetic representation that takes into account the likely source language. Next, this phonetic representation is converted into a pan-European 'average' representation, allowing comparison between different versions of essentially the same word from different languages.

This class is intentionally immutable and thread-safe. If you wish to alter the settings for a PhoneticEngine, you must make a new one with the updated settings.

Ported from phoneticengine.php

Since:
1.6

      @Deprecated public PhoneticEngine(NameType nameType, RuleType ruleType, boolean concatenate)
      Deprecated.
      Use builder() instead.
      Generates a new, fully-configured phonetic engine.
      Parameters:
      nameType - the type of names it will use, null is treated as NameType.GENERIC.
      ruleType - the type of rules it will apply, null is treated as RuleType.APPROX.
      concatenate - if it will concatenate multiple encodings.

    • PhoneticEngine

      @Deprecated public PhoneticEngine(NameType nameType, RuleType ruleType, boolean concatenate, int maxPhonemes)
      Deprecated.
      Use builder() instead.
      Generates a new, fully-configured phonetic engine.
      Parameters:
      nameType - the type of names it will use, null is treated as NameType.GENERIC.
      ruleType - the type of rules it will apply, null is treated as RuleType.APPROX.
      concatenate - if it will concatenate multiple encodings.
      maxPhonemes - the maximum number of phonemes that will be handled, less than 0 will reset to the default of 20.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if ruleType is RULES.
      Since:
      1.7

      public String encode(String input, Languages.LanguageSet languageSet)
      Encodes an input string into an output phonetic representation, given a set of possible origin languages.
      Parameters:
      input - String to phoneticise; a String with dashes or spaces separating each word, not null.
      languageSet - set of possible origin languages.
      Returns:
      A phonetic representation of the input; a String containing '-'-separated phonetic representations of the input.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - Thrown if the input is longer than the maximum allowed length.
